description: A class annotated with @Entity whose instances map to rows of a table, with a no-argument constructor that the provider calls.
The set of entities one EntityManager tracks, holding at most one instance per row, which lives as long as the transaction in a Spring service.
Hibernate comparing each managed entity with the snapshot taken at load time during flush and issuing an UPDATE for every difference.
A managed entity is tracked by an open context, while a detached one has an id but no context, so its changes are not written.
The operation that copies the state of a detached entity onto a managed instance and returns that managed instance.
The strategy that produces primary keys: IDENTITY from the database, SEQUENCE from a sequence, UUID in the application, or AUTO chosen by Hibernate.
The spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto property that lets Hibernate create, update or validate the schema, where validate is the safe choice with migrations.
